Calibration.title: Camera Calibration

prepare.lede: Calibrate once per camera and lens. Every project filmed with them reuses the profile.
prepare.boardText: Open the board full-screen and photograph it with the camera and lens you use in the field.
prepare.tipFlat: Keep the screen flat and still; avoid glare.
prepare.tipAngles: Take 15 to 30 photos from varied angles and distances.
prepare.tipCorners: In some photos, let the board reach the image corners.
prepare.skip: Already have photos? Go straight to step 2.
prepare.photosText: A folder of JPG or PNG photos of the board, all from the same camera.
prepare.dropHint: Drag a folder of photos here
prepare.tooFew_one: Only {{count}} photo. {{min}} or more give a steadier calibration; you can still solve.
prepare.tooFew_other: Only {{count}} photos. {{min}} or more give a steadier calibration; you can still solve.

actions.addFrames: Add frames hitting edges/corners; vary angle & distance.
actions.pushBoard: Push board nearer sensor edges; allow some marker clipping.
actions.increaseSharpness: Increase sharpness (more light, lower ISO), reduce screen moiré (resize board).
actions.varyViewpoints: Capture from varied viewpoints (tilt/pan/roll) and distances.
actions.ensureCorners: Ensure corners appear across the whole sensor; avoid heavy cropping.
actions.reshoot: Re-shoot with better coverage; if persists, inspect image readout/metadata.
